title.zh: 【以太坊研究员提出 EIP-8453 草案，拟将交易最终确认时间缩短至约 4 分钟】
title.en: 【以太坊研究员提出 EIP-8453 草案，拟将交易最终确认时间缩短至约 4 分钟】

current_state.zh: Ethereum researchers including Ben Edgington submitted draft EIP-8453, which proposes decoupling validator block-selection votes from finality votes to reduce transaction finality from roughly 16 minutes to about 4 minutes and ease future quantum-resistant signature adoption.
current_state.en: Ethereum researchers including Ben Edgington submitted draft EIP-8453, which proposes decoupling validator block-selection votes from finality votes to reduce transaction finality from roughly 16 minutes to about 4 minutes and ease future quantum-resistant signature adoption.
